title: PATCH /api/projects/[projectId]/audits/[auditId] request body
description: Shape only. question_marked[].addressed is REQUIRED by this schema — a new tightening: a missing addressed used to pass here and then vanish from the stored audit. The question-id lookup stays a domain 400 (src/domain/finding-review.ts:129-135). candidate_promotions[].action is a free string so the domain's own 'unknown candidate action' 400 survives (src/domain/candidate-review.ts:206-208); the index bound is the domain's too. Unknown finding ids, the wording gate and the consent posture stay domain rules and keep their 400 (src/domain/finding-review.ts:89-107, src/domain/candidate-review.ts:58-65).

consent.description: Unconstrained on purpose: the consent-posture rule is the domain's and answers 400 (src/domain/candidate-review.ts:52-67).
